app_info.subtitle: Story mapping tool
app_info.description: Cartographer helps product teams create and maintain user story maps in ChatGPT. Users can organize journeys, steps, and story cards; plan releases with milestones; track workflow status; associate personas and customers; collaborate through comments; and manage supporting whiteboard canvases.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves the authenticated user's identity and organization role without changing workspace data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads identity and access information within the user's private Cartographer account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, update, delete, or detach any Cartographer data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists spaces in the active organization without modifying them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads spaces from the user's private Cartographer organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change or remove any space.

justifications.open_world_justification: Creates data only inside the user's private Cartographer organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a new space without deleting or replacing existing workspace data.

test_cases.description: Build a complete three-tier story map in an existing space.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a project called Customer Onboarding in my General space with journeys for discovering the product, signing up, completing setup, and inviting teammates. Include steps, objectives, risks, and open questions.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates the project in the General space with four journeys, steps under each journey, and typed story cards (objectives, risks, questions) under the steps, then summarizes what it added.

test_cases.description: Summarize the backbone of an existing project.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find my Mobile Checkout project and summarize its user journey from left to right, including the number of story cards under each step.
test_cases.expected_output: Finds the Mobile Checkout project and returns its journeys in order, each with its steps and the number of story cards under each step.

test_cases.description: Add a risk and a question without duplicating existing cards.
test_cases.user_prompt: In the Mobile Checkout project, review all existing cards and add a risk about payment-provider downtime plus a question about guest checkout under the most relevant steps.
test_cases.expected_output: Reads the existing cards, adds one risk card and one question card under the most relevant steps without duplicating existing cards, and reports where each was added.

test_cases.description: Preview a cascading deletion without deleting anything.
test_cases.user_prompt: In the Mobile Checkout project, show me exactly what would be removed if I delete the Payment journey, but do not delete anything.
test_cases.expected_output: Calls cards_bulk_delete without confirm to get a preview, lists the Payment journey and the steps and story cards that would be removed, and leaves the project unchanged.

test_cases.description: Show a story map inline in the conversation.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the Mobile Checkout story map.
test_cases.expected_output: Shows the Mobile Checkout board inline in the conversation. The user can expand it to fullscreen and open or edit cards directly.

negative_test_cases.description: Answers general product-management questions without using Cartographer, because no workspace data or action is needed.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Explain the difference between a product roadmap and a user story map.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Answers general product-management questions without using Cartographer, because no workspace data or action is needed.

negative_test_cases.description: Does not use Cartographer for calendar scheduling, which it cannot do.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Schedule a planning meeting with my design team next Tuesday at 10 AM.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not use Cartographer for calendar scheduling, which it cannot do.

negative_test_cases.description: Does not use Cartographer to generate standalone images, which are outside its story-mapping workflows.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Generate a polished hero illustration for my landing page.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not use Cartographer to generate standalone images, which are outside its story-mapping workflows.
